note: Every endpoint is a biomarker or a disease-specific outcome: insulin sensitivity by tracer/clamp in insulin-resistant subjects, flow-mediated dilation during a glucose challenge, ALSFRS-R slope in ALS (a serious clinical population, and the record carries an erratum), and TPN-associated cholestasis in neonates, which was NULL. There is no general-use patient-important outcome here, and the studied doses sit above the uniform 500 mg catalog amount.
